## tibble tsibble dable fable

This would be great to add to instructional material.

| data type | where it comes from | package | what plots it | what is it |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------- | ------------- | ---------- |
| tibble    | `read_csv()`, `import()`, `tibble()` | tidyverse | ggplot - not autoplot   |  |
| tsibble   | `tsibble()`         | tsibble | ggplot & autoplot | tibble for time series, requires a time index |
| mable     | `model()`           |  | Not plotted directly; used to extract components (`components()`) or generate forecasts (`forecast()`). Hint: use `select()` to pick a single model if you fit multiple. | **Model Table:** Contains fitted time-series models (e.g., ARIMA, ETS) stored in columns. |
| dable     | `components()` on a decomposition model like `STL()` | autoplot | **Decomposition Table:** Contains the extracted seasonal, trend, and remainder components. |
| fable     | `forecast()`        | fable   | autoplot & ggplot, but autoplot will add confidence intervals | **Forecast Table:** Contains forecast data and confidence intervals. |
